Audio Priority Bar 2.0.0 is a Swift 6 rewrite for macOS 14 and newer. It keeps
the newer `app.audioprioritybar` identity and migrates recognized settings from
the public V1 `com.example.AudioPriorityBar` domain. Existing V2 settings win.
The implementation is rebuilt around a tested priority core, explicit CoreAudio
listener lifecycles, and a native AppKit menu bar panel.

## Highlights

- Separate Speakers, Headphones, and Microphones lists
- Automatic headphone preference with speaker fallback
- One-click manual override that keeps the selected device active
- Drag reordering within lists and between Speakers and Headphones
- Per-list visibility, Never Auto-Select, and role-scoped device settings
- Physical USB headset microphones can move with their matching output
- Volume and mute status, including keyboard-accessible device actions
- Settings window and Open at Login
- Locally verified Jabra Link 380 and research-based Link 390 power-off detection
- Light and dark appearances with VoiceOver names, values, and keyboard actions

## Install

```bash
brew install --cask camguillory/tap/audio-priority-bar
```

The fully qualified command trusts only this cask. Alternatively, download
`AudioPriorityBar.zip` and `AudioPriorityBar.zip.sha256` below into the same
folder, verify the archive, and move the app to `/Applications`:

```bash
shasum -a 256 -c AudioPriorityBar.zip.sha256
```

The release is universal for Apple silicon and Intel. It is ad-hoc signed, not
signed with an Apple Developer ID or notarized. If macOS blocks the first
launch, open **System Settings > Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**.

Jabra Link monitoring may request Input Monitoring permission. Link 390 support
uses the hardware measurements from
[tobi/AudioPriorityBar#32](https://github.com/tobi/AudioPriorityBar/pull/32)
and has not been locally verified for this release. Monitoring fails open when
the link state cannot be read.

Because V1 used a different bundle identifier, Input Monitoring and Open at
Login may require approval again after upgrading.
